events.title: Joined ePharma
events.text: Started as Frontend Engineer, building responsive and accessible production interfaces with reusable components.

events.title: Back to the original project
events.text: Returned to the original product, working with JavaScript, jQuery and Java and managing work in Wrike within Scrum.

events.title: Left ePharma
events.text: After four years, I left ePharma.

events.title: Started freelancing
events.text: Landing pages and websites for clients, including a site with a backoffice for a pyrotechnics company.

events.title: SaveSpot
events.text: Booking app taken from concept to launch, published on the App Store and Google Play.

events.title: Kyuar
events.text: Restaurant management platform: QR Code ordering, backoffice, invoicing, reservations and team management.

events.title: Mingle
events.text: Interactive platform for events of any kind, joined with a QR code. Roll turns every phone into an analogue film camera, with the photos revealed together at the end of the night. Plus Cheers for guest messages, Jukebox for song requests, Buzz for live quizzes and Pulse, LED wristbands synced to the music.

events.title: Live shows & SFX
events.text: Part of the crew on large live shows, where timing is to the second and safety rules are strict.

events.title: Pyro website
events.text: Website and backoffice for the company: services, portfolio and three languages.

events.title: engi.studio
events.text: Show control web app for a client: lighting, audio and video cues fired at the exact second, on a Raspberry Pi with GPS time.

events.title: OurUber
events.text: Ride-hailing app I built end to end, with client and driver modes, live rides on a map and driver ratings.
